content.content: The acceptance suites are black-box: they drive the built binary as a subprocess through `assert_cmd`, each case in a `tempfile`-scoped scratch directory, rather than calling the assembled entry in-process.
content.rationale: I1 fixes the stack the crate is built from; the acceptance suites are built from it too, and this node fixes their form — a real process is driven, one scratch directory per case, rather than the assembled entry in-process. Keeping the check on the built binary means it sees the same surface anyone runs.
